mission_03: Partial derivatives measure how a multivariate function changes when you vary one input while holding others constant. The gradient vector collects all partial derivatives and points in the direction of steepest ascent. The directional derivative in direction v equals the dot product of the gradient with the unit vector v. In machine learning, the gradient of the loss function with respect to model parameters tells us how to adjust each parameter to reduce error. Understanding partial derivatives is essential for working with functions of multiple variables, which is the norm in ML where models have millions of parameters.
